security.title: Your client relationships deserve more than a convenient calendar.
security.subtitle: We built Cadence with the protections you'd expect from professional infrastructure.

security.items.title: Data kept separate
security.items.text: Every account is strictly isolated at the database level itself, not only by the application.

security.items.title: Login code protected
security.items.text: Your 6-digit verification code is never stored in plain text — only its cryptographic signature is.

security.items.title: Restricted public access
security.items.text: Booking and confirmation pages never get direct database access: only tightly scoped functions.

security.items.title: Verified payments
security.items.text: Every Stripe transaction is validated by signature verification before being trusted.

faq.title: Still have a question?

faq.items.q: Do I need a credit card to start?
faq.items.a: No. The Free-mium plan is free and never asks for a card.

faq.items.q: Can I import my existing contacts?
faq.items.a: Yes, via CSV or vCard (.vcf) files, with automatic duplicate detection.

faq.items.q: Do I have to replace my current calendar?
faq.items.a: No. Cadence can work alongside your current habits — it's not all-or-nothing.

faq.items.q: What happens when someone declines an appointment?
faq.items.a: You're notified immediately in your dashboard, along with their response message if they left one.
Yes: strictly account-scoped access, login codes are never stored in plain text, and payments are verified by signature. See the Security section above.

faq.items.q: What happens if I reach my plan limit?
faq.items.a: You're warned and invited to upgrade — nothing gets deleted or abruptly blocked.
